page.overview:
Who is Hototogisu?

Hototogisu is a Marine Vice Admiral and a subordinate of Vice Admiral Tsuru.

Hototogisu is a regular-sized, young woman with light hair. Like many Marines, she wears her high-collared sailing coat draped over her shoulders. She also wears a bucket hat with the Marine logo engraved on it and a loose tie with her spotted shirt.

Hototogisu cares about Marine cadets and was willing to assault Vice Admiral Garp for giving what she saw as bad advice to them. She also denounces the idea of some lives being greater than others, and believes all lives have equal worth and should be respected as such.

As a Vice Admiral, she has authority over lower-ranking Marines.
